seo_title: Cost of Living in Yerevan 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Yerevan per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: Simple bureaucracy for Russian citizens, low rent and food costs, and an easy daily routine. A good choice for those who want to relocate visa-free and start working remotely right away.
pros: Minimal bureaucracy — a sole proprietorship opens in a day
Russian is widely used in everyday life
A walkable city with no need for a car
cons: Hot dry summers, +35°C is the norm
Much of the infrastructure is Soviet-era, without major upgrades

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: 180 days on a Russian passport, with a stamp at the border.

visa_steps.title: SSN (social number)
visa_steps.description: Obtained at the tax office in a single day — needed for an account and a sole proprietorship.

visa_steps.title: Opening a sole proprietorship
visa_steps.description: Through the OSS office — set up in a day, with a 5% tax on turnover.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Ameriabank or Inecobank — both are friendly to Russians and offer online banking.

visa_steps.title: Residence permit (optional)
visa_steps.description: Through employment, business or marriage — obtained in 2–3 months.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Yerevan?
faq.answer: No, you need dram or foreign currency. Local cards with international payments are issued after you open an account.

faq.question: Which bank should I choose in Yerevan?
faq.answer: Ameriabank — friendly to Russians, with good online banking. Inecobank — for business.

faq.question: How much does a sole proprietorship cost in Yerevan?
faq.answer: Registration is free. The tax is 5% of turnover for microbusiness, with 18% VAT on turnover above $80,000.

faq.question: What is healthcare like in Yerevan?
faq.answer: Private clinics are good, with appointments at 2,500–4,500 ₽. Many doctors speak Russian.

faq.question: Is winter harsh in Yerevan?
faq.answer: No, usually +0…+5°C. Heating works everywhere and snow is rare.

faq.question: Is the internet good in Yerevan?
faq.answer: Yes, fibre at 100+ Mbps, with plans at 1,200–2,000 ₽ a month.

reviews.text: I opened a sole proprietorship in a day and got a residence permit in two months. Yerevan isn't touristy, and that's a plus — you feel like a resident.
Low prices, a calm atmosphere, great coffee. The downside — in summer you can't survive without air conditioning.
